what: Work sections stacked in one spot switch to the next every 3.6 seconds: the new section lays on top and turns on over .6s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1) while the previous one stays underneath and fades out. Each time, the new section’s progress bar fills 0 to 100% linearly over 3.6s. While hovered it doesn’t advance (3.6 seconds restart on release), and the current photo follows the cursor by (cursor − photo’s bottom-right corner) × .02 over .15s ease-out, returning to place over .7s ease-out on release — a showcase panel presenting one book cover at a time

options.each: Time spent on one slide (seconds), default 3.6 — the progress bar fills over this length too
options.fade: Duration for a new section to turn on (sec), default .6
options.tick: Interval (seconds) for checking whether it’s time to advance, default .25 (original setInterval 250ms — so the actual interval is 3.6~3.85 seconds)
options.follow: Share of the cursor movement the photo follows, default .02 — 0 means it does not follow
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Section (child, paged if two or more) — stacked in one cell
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo that follows the cursor inside the section
options.[data-fx-part=track] · [data-fx-part=fil: In-Section progress bar frame and filling bar (optional)

from.where: index.html .yg-works (original Featured Carousel — 6 slides, opacity 600ms cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), checks every 250ms and advances after 3600ms, progress bar width 3600ms linear, Image translate ×.02 150ms ease-out / 700ms ease-out)
